title: Silver Lilac Warehouse Pilot - Field Scratchpad
content:
Purpose: capture raw notes from intake calls + quick on-site observations for Silver Lilac (3PL warehouse) pilot. Keeping this messy — will extract PRD bullets after the next sync.

High-level ask from customer: build an on-prem inference gateway to power a dock-level conversational assistant for inbound receiving and damage triage. Primary users are floor supervisors (tablets) and inbound dock clerks (wearables / headsets).

Primary success criteria (customer):
- Reduce inbound triage time by >= 30% (measured week-over-week floor throughput).
- False positive damage flags < 5% (manual audit sampling).
- 99% availability during 07:00-19:00 local shift window.

Key constraints heard on call (technical / ops):
- Network: single 1Gb MPLS connection to corporate DC, occasional flaps during shift change (2–3x/month). No direct internet egress allowed from floor VLAN.
- Security: corporate KMS (Hashi HSM) for secrets; strict change window for firewall rules (midnight–02:00).
- Hardware: Customer can supply 2x A100 (80GB) in a rack for pilot, but they want software that can run on 1x A40 class fallback if needed.
- Latency target: ~<150ms p95 for short prompts (3–40 tokens new content); streaming acceptable if overall tail stays under 300ms.
- Data retention: all transcripts must be retained for 90 days in customer S3 (on-prem Ceph object store) for audit.

On-site notes from walkthrough (02/01/2026):
- Dock tablets are ruggedized Android, stock browser + local PWA. Apps connect through corporate proxy.
- Background noise high — hopeful customer will provide headset-equipped clerks for triage to improve audio quality.
- Barcode scanner model: Zebra DS3678 — returns binary control sequences for some configs (we need to normalize).
- Floor supervisor wants ability to quickly mark transcript snippets as "safety" or "customer claim" — sticky tag that flows to audit log.
- Power redundancy: UPS at rack, but no generator for whole pod. Plan for graceful drain on power warnings.

Immediate functional requirements (draft):
- On-prem Redwood Private Gateway running in customer k8s (air-gapped mode) with control plane callbacks over proxy.
- Model selection: run quantized open model (<=40B float-16 equivalent) with KV cache support; allow auto-fallback to smaller 7B distilled for high-concurrency spikes.
- Prefix caching for frequent SKU/incident prompts (customer provides common phrases list).
- Short-turn audio->text->assistant flow. We will NOT do on-device STT for v1; use internal STT instance behind the gateway.
- Tagging metadata: user_id, dock_id, shift_id, confidence score, audio file link, transcript. Must be included in every response payload.
- Audit export job: nightly push to Ceph S3 bucket with rotation policy.

Operational gotchas (things to watch):
- Proxy auth: corporate proxy requires NTLM auth for external callbacks. Our current Private agent doesn't support NTLM — block unless we add a proxy auth shim. (Action: RAVI to prototype a sidecar auth adapter.)
- Firewall change windows means upgrades must be planned off-hours; customer expects patch doc + rollback at least 48h in advance.
- Barcode scanner sequences cause tokenization oddities in prompts (lots of control chars) — need a pre-normalizer to strip or replace with SKU tokens.
- Acoustic model mismatch: noisy warehouse + overlapping chatter will drastically lower STT confidence. Plan for "clarify" fallback messages rather than brittle defaults.

Privacy / compliance notes:
- No PHI expected but some PII (driver names, customer billing IDs). Need to confirm retention & redaction policy with legal.
- Customer requests option to run local redaction step before persisting transcripts (PII scrub regex + allowlist).

Potential UX flows (v1):
1) Dock clerk scans inbound, headset sends short audio: "Package damaged, corner crushed" -> STT -> assistant replies with structured triage: severity, recommended action, create incident ticket (stub) -> operator confirms -> ticket created in their Jira-like internal tool via webhook.
2) Supervisor multi-turn: "show me all damage incidents last 4 hours for dock 3" -> assistant queries local index (embeddings on Ceph) -> returns summaries and quick filters.

Perf / testing plan (pilot):
- Baseline: collect 24h of raw transcripts (anonymized) before model tuning to measure current triage latencies and false positive rates.
- Load test: simulate 60 concurrent dock clerks, 120 short requests/min peak. Validate tail latencies with A100 + fallback path (A40/7B).
- Prompt set: assemble 200 canonical triage prompts + 100 supervisor queries for eval.

Open questions to clarify with Silver Lilac (for next call):
- Confirm proxy auth method (NTLM vs token) and whether they can open an allowlist for our agent's control plane callbacks.
- Which exact HSM/KMS integration is preferred (Hashi HSM team contact?), and do they require key wrap from customer side?
- Who owns the ticket creation endpoint (internal service name & sample payload)?
- Can they provide a sample of noisy audio clips and barcode raw bytes for pre-normalization tests?

Next steps / action items (owner — ETA):
- Draft minimal deployment playbook showing k8s manifests + required firewall/proxy ports (Maya) — ETA 2026-02-06.
- Ravi: prototype proxy auth sidecar that can NTLM-auth outbound and forward to agent (spike) — ETA 2026-02-10.
- Sofia: collect 24h anonymized transcript baseline template & sample audio spec; request from Silver Lilac (outreach) — ETA 2026-02-05.
- Oliver: evaluate model candidates for quantization profile (7B fallback and 13B/30B primary) and estimate VRAM + throughput on A100 (80GB) — ETA 2026-02-08.
- Schedule follow-up with Silver Lilac tech lead (Aaron Leung) for proxy/HSM deep dive — target 2026-02-09.

Meeting crumbs / informal notes:
- Supervisor Teresa was skeptical about accuracy but liked the idea of the "safety" tag flow. She wants manual override to force immediate escalation.
- They called out union rules about surveillance — keep legal looped in re: workforce monitoring.
- Coffee quality on site is actually excellent (irrelevant, but helps rapport).

Draft tags for internal tracking: silver-lilac, warehouse-pilot, onprem-gateway, proxy-ntlm, hsm-integration, stt-noise

End of scratchpad — will clean into a short PRD + risk register after Ravi spike and we get audio samples.
